meta.outcome: Therapeutic failure in cutaneous leishmaniasis (final outcome, assessed up to week 26)
meta.note: Models trained on the full dataset. Honest out-of-sample discrimination (repeated CV): PRE ROC-AUC ~0.75, EoTx ~0.70.

random_forest.note: Probability forest. Prediction = mean of per-tree leaf probabilities. Leaves hold P(failure). ranger sends values <= split_condition to 'yes' (left).
